apps.name: Crop Watch
apps.tagline: Drive the robot and spot problems as it goes
apps.description: Watch both cameras while the robot moves down the rows. Problems are outlined as they are found, and every one is pinned on the field map with its location.

apps.name: Mission Planner
apps.tagline: Plan a route, or drive it yourself
apps.description: Set the robot to cover the rows on its own, or take the controls. Includes the sprayer: arm it, set the nozzle and flow, and treat flagged plants as you go.

apps.name: Crop Health
apps.tagline: What was found, where, and what to do
apps.description: Every flagged plant from every scouting run, grouped into hotspots with a photo, its GPS location and the row to walk to. Tells you what it is and what to do.

apps.name: Dashboard
apps.tagline: How the robot itself is doing
apps.description: Battery, signal, sensors and onboard computer at a glance, plus the settings that change how the robot drives and how sensitive its detection is.

apps.name: Crop Chat
apps.tagline: Ask about this field in your language
apps.description: Ask what is wrong in the field, where the worst plants are and what to do about them, in English, Hindi or twenty-one other Indian languages. Answers are read from this robot's own scouting data.
